schema_version: 1
layers:
  domain: internal/domain
  usecase: internal/usecase
  ports: internal/port
  transport: internal/transport
  infrastructure: internal/infrastructure
  composition_root: cmd/user-service
ownership:
  user: [user lifecycle, status, profile fields, avatar file reference]
  external: [credentials and tokens, roles and permissions, file bytes and image derivatives]
known_conflicts:
  - user_identity and user_provider overlap ms-go-auth login identity ownership.
known_security_risks:
  - X-User-Id and X-User-Role bypass JWT verification without a trusted-proxy check.
  - INTERNAL_API_TOKEN defaults to change-me.
